_doc: Bridge conformance fixture — typical CellDelta emitted by the Task 1.5 worker on every tick: one symbol, one bucket, single-side bid + ask, single trade. The companion .msgpack file is the byte-level oracle. Hand-edit this JSON to change the logical value, then regenerate the .msgpack via `cargo run --bin gen-fixtures` from projects/tape/worker/. NEVER hand-edit the .msgpack file. See ADR-003 § Consequences.
